source_issues.description: The feature list mentions 0.01% repetitive duty, while the maximum-rating footnote specifies a nonrepetitive pulse. That footnote refers to TA derating; Figure 2 uses initial TJ and separate typical/safety-operation-area curves. These are retained as separate conditions/rating scopes, not declared a contradiction or manufacturer error. Application repetition and temperature limits cannot be inferred without thermal and waveform inputs, and manufacturer clarification where needed.

Fault waveform, polarity, available current/energy, duration, repetition, source impedance, series protection, layout inductance, initial junction temperature and actual heat path are unknown. No continuous-overvoltage, fuse coordination, safe failure mode or protected-circuit survival is established.

User orderable suffix, supplier identity, footprint orientation and protected-node limits are unprovided. KE marking is shared by A/CA columns and does not uniquely prove polarity. No blanket ESD, surge, USB, automotive or end-product certification follows from this batch.
